To resolve this, please follow these steps:


Assuming the system allows you to change the LogonID for a given user, (use of Active Directory can prevent this  for example), provided the corresponding STAFF table entry remains for the same individual, there should be no issue.
Likewise if the User's name is changed (for example after marriage etc), the same should be the case.

The system records the STAFF Table record ID against any data or transactions associated with the given user, rather than their name or LogonID, so that will remain unchanged for any historical data and carry forward as the STAFF Table entry remains in use on an ongoing bases.
